limits: Runtime input/rendering checks ran on Linux, not on the user Windows GPU or physical controller.
Windows x64 build, PE imports, included resources and ZIP CRC checked; Windows executable was not run here.
Ball contacts use a 10 ms physics step and the retargeted mesh; these checks do not prove absence of every possible collision bug.
